en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 6. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to me by Sa’d b. Abdillah from Ahmad b. Yahya al-Khazaz from Ammar b. Ibrahim from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
“There are some men about whom Allah will not care at all. They have wombs like women.” Imam was asked, “Don’t these men get pregnant?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Their wombs are like balloons.”
